question: How did the Supreme Lord and the gods provide refuge to the serpent king?
premises: The Supreme Lord placed the serpent king on the seat of his matted hair.
After that, all the hosts of gods bore him on their heads.
The serpent king was thus given a divine refuge.
inference: The serpent king's refuge becomes a mark of supreme honor, shared by Śiva and all the gods.
plain_english: The Supreme Lord placed the serpent king upon the seat of his own matted locks; then all the hosts of gods bore him upon their heads.
